name: N8N Workflow Generator
description: Generates n8n workflows from natural language prompts using AI and can optionally auto-import them into a linked n8n instance.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key for generating workflows.

N8N_URL.description: (Optional) URL of your n8n instance (e.g., https://your-n8n.herokuapp.com) for auto-importing workflows. Leave blank to disable.

N8N_API_KEY.description: (Optional) Your n8n API key (from Admin settings > API) for auto-importing workflows. Leave blank to disable.

FLASK_DEBUG.description: Set to 0 for production on Heroku.
